content:
Mica (PM): quick idea — add a 'federated saved view' in Console that lets folks pin route+model combos (and filters) and see a compact quota/telemetry preview. anyone worried about API shape or telemetry accuracy?
Alisha - Eng: sounds useful. main API question: extend saved_view with an array of pins vs create a new resource that references route+model ids. prefer reference-only to avoid huge payloads.
BenG: reference-only + validate on write. embedding full filters can cause drift and heavy writes. also DB migration cost if we add big json blobs.
Samira - Design: UI notes: show pins as small chips with model badges + route name. preview should show three numbers: recent qps, 24h avg latency, and token-cost estimate. hover -> explain assumptions. :point_up:
Jorge: telemetry accuracy roadblock — our sampling for telemetry is per-route, not per (route,model). to get per-pin metrics we either: 1) tag requests at ingest with view_id (hard, need routing change) or 2) compute intersection offline by joining route traces with model routing logs (costly). leaning to (2) initially.
Li - Data: joining is doable for a best-effort preview: take sampled traces and model decision logs, estimate confidence interval. we should expose a "sample_rate" and "ci" in the preview so users know variance.
Nikhil - Platform: quota preview needs routing-policy hints — e.g., routes with fallback to cheaper model will understate worst-case cost. we should surface routing tier used for the estimate and add a checkbox "assume worst-case fallback". also watch out for exposing internal tier names in the UI.
Mica (PM): good call. final list of requirements: saved view references (route_id, model_id, optional filter set), preview with qps/latency/cost + sample_rate/ci, routing-policy hint toggle, and rollout gated. can folks paste a minimal API sketch we can iterate on?
Alisha - Eng: draft shape (pseudo):
```json
{
  "id": "sv_...",
  "owner_team": "console",
  "pins": [
    {"route_id": "r_123", "model_id": "m_45", "filters": [{"field":"status","op":"=","value":"200"}]}
  ],
  "preview_opts": {"assume_worst_case": false}
}
```
BenG: add a "validation_status" + "last_validated_ts" so we can run background checks (models may be retired).
Samira - Design: for rollout: start hidden behind a feature flag + quick access in the route inspector -> "Add to federated view" flow. also add a tiny telemetry disclaimer: "estimates from sampled telemetry".
Jorge: implementation plan: index model routing logs by route_id + model_id and run a daily aggregation job that outputs per-(route,model) metrics. that avoids changing ingest path. will take ~2 sprint effort.
Li - Data: agree, daily aggregates + sample_rate + CI columns. for interactive explore we can fallback to on-demand join but rate-limit it.
Nikhil - Platform: quota calc: use tokens_per_response * avg_qps * 24 to show daily cost; fallback toggle affects tokens_per_response estimate. must ensure we use cost config from billing API (don't hardcode).
Mica (PM): awesome. next steps: Alisha/Jorge pair to draft API + data job ticket, Samira to mock compact preview microcopy, Li to propose CI method, Nikhil to wire billing hook. I'll gate behind FF and propose canary release to 5% orgs.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature-flag infra updated for "federated_saved_view". ETA: 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC
BenG: one more thought — saved view sharing/visibility rules. should they follow route ownership or be team-scoped? open question for PM/Legal.
Mica (PM): noted. we can default to owner_team + expand later. thanks all, will follow up with a google doc and tickets.
